title: Rout on Friday: Nasdaq Crashes 5.7% in the Week's Capitulation
lede: Friday brought the heaviest selling of the week. The Nasdaq 100 plunged 5.67%, the S&P 500 lost 3.64%, and Ether dropped 7.64% as a global risk selloff hit full force into the weekend.

paras: The IHSG fell 0.92% to 5,146.33 — a third straight loss, though Jakarta held up noticeably better than New York on the day.
It was a rout. The S&P 500 dropped 3.64% and the Nasdaq 100 crashed 5.67% in the week's worst session, while the Dow fell 1.98%. Gold lost 3.67%, confirming there was nowhere to hide.
Bitcoin broke below $59,000, falling 4.90% to $58,952. Ether was hit harder, down 7.64% to $1,623. By Friday's close, Bitcoin had lost roughly 7% in three sessions.
